_comment: Unattended game runs for run_tests.ps1. Each scenario is one run of ps2EntryRunner.exe.
input: pad script 'tick:button[:holdTicks],...' (tick = window frame, ~60 per second).
shots: window frames whose picture is saved; checks of type 'shot' refer to them.
known_fail: the check is expected to fail for a known reason; it is reported but does not fail the run.
Golden pictures live in tests/golden/ (game content: never committed, see .gitignore).

scenarios.name: boot_to_language_menu
scenarios.description: Boot, PRESS START, the language menu draws on the GPU renderer.

checks.label: run ends by frame budget (no hang, no crash)
no bad indirect branch in game code
GIF stream stays in step (no garbage registers)
UBISOUND reads the disc through the host reader
sound is audible
